name: Outpatient Clinic
description: Referral, triage, scheduling and diagnostics for patients referred to an outpatient clinic by their GP.

outpatient_care.name: Outpatient Care
outpatient_care.description: Everything involved in getting a GP-referred patient seen.

referral_triage.name: Referral Triage
referral_triage.description: Deciding what happens to a referral once it arrives: accept it, ask for more information, or decline it.

appointment_scheduling.name: Appointment Scheduling
appointment_scheduling.description: Turning an accepted case into a booked clinic slot, and keeping the record of clinics, slots, bookings and cancellations.

patient_identity.name: Patient Identity
patient_identity.description: Knowing who a patient is, and what every other system that refers to them calls them.

gp_practice_system.name: GP Practice System
gp_practice_system.description: The GP's own practice management system. Not ours to model inside: it sends referrals in its own message format, and every practice may run a different one.

practice_system_interface.name: Practice System Interface
practice_system_interface.description: What the practice system publishes to us.

referral_submitted.name: Referral Submitted
referral_submitted.description: A referral has been sent by the GP's practice system, in its own message format.

gp_referral_message.name: GP Referral Message
gp_referral_message.description: The referral exactly as the practice system sends it.

referral_reference.name: referralReference
referral_reference.description: The practice system's own reference for this referral.

gp_patient_number.name: gpPatientNumber
gp_patient_number.description: The patient, by the GP's own patient number.

laboratory.name: Laboratory
laboratory.description: The clinic's contracted laboratory service. Takes a test order and answers with a result later, in its own report format. Not ours to model inside.

lab_interface.name: Lab Interface
lab_interface.description: What the lab offers us, and what it publishes back.

order_test.name: Order Test
order_test.description: Takes a test order, in the lab's own request shape.

test_result_reported.name: Test Result Reported
test_result_reported.description: A result is ready, reported in the lab's own format.

test_order_request.name: Test Order Request
test_order_request.description: The order, in the lab's own terms.

test_order_accepted.name: Test Order Accepted
test_order_accepted.description: The lab's acknowledgement that it has taken the order.

lab_result_message.name: Lab Result Message
lab_result_message.description: The result, in the lab's own report format.

clinical_coding_regulator.name: Clinical Coding Regulator
clinical_coding_regulator.description: Publishes the national clinical coding standard every clinical record must follow. Offers nothing to call: only the standard itself, as data.

clinical_code.name: Clinical Code
clinical_code.description: A single code from the current published coding standard, and the version of the standard it was taken from.

code_belongs_to_the_published_standard.name: Code Belongs To The Published Standard
code_belongs_to_the_published_standard.description: A clinical code is only ever one the regulator's current coding standard actually lists.

patient_records.name: Patient Records
patient_records.description: Holds who our patients are, and what every outside system that refers to them calls them.

patient_record.name: Patient Record
patient_record.description: One patient, and every outside reference we hold for them.

register_patient.name: Register Patient
register_patient.description: Creates the record for a patient the clinic has not seen before. Called by the records officer, or on the records officer's behalf when a referral names a patient not yet known.

patient_registered.name: Patient Registered
patient_registered.description: A new patient has been added to Records.

link_gp_practice_reference.name: Link GP Practice Reference
link_gp_practice_reference.description: Records that a GP practice system knows this patient by a given number. Called by the records officer while matching a referral to a patient.

link_lab_reference.name: Link Lab Reference
link_lab_reference.description: Records that the laboratory knows this patient by a given reference. Called by the records officer.

patient.name: Patient
patient.description: Somebody the clinic has, or will, care for.

external_identifier.name: External Identifier
external_identifier.description: One outside system's own reference for this patient. Kinds say which system and hold that system's reference.

gp_practice_reference.name: GP Practice Reference
gp_practice_reference.description: This patient's number in a GP's own practice system.

lab_reference.name: Lab Reference
lab_reference.description: This patient's reference at the laboratory.

one_external_reference_per_system.name: One External Reference Per System
one_external_reference_per_system.description: A patient never holds two references from the same outside system -- if a second one turns up, it is a mistake to catch, not a second identity to keep.

patient_directory.name: Patient Directory
patient_directory.description: Fronts Records for the rest of the clinic.

get_patient_summary.name: Get Patient Summary
get_patient_summary.description: Looks a patient up by their internal id.

register_patient_on_referral.name: Register Patient On Referral
register_patient_on_referral.description: Every registered referral names a patient Records should know about, new or existing.

patient.name: Patient
patient.definition: Somebody the clinic has, or will, care for.

external_identifier.name: External Identifier
external_identifier.definition: The reference an outside system -- a GP practice, the lab -- uses for one of our patients.

patient_summary.name: Patient Summary
patient_summary.description: What Records answers with when another part of the clinic looks a patient up.

patient_lookup_request.name: Patient Lookup Request
patient_lookup_request.description: Which patient is being asked for.

patient_details.name: Patient Details
patient_details.description: What is known about a new patient when they are first registered.

gp_reference_details.name: GP Reference Details
gp_reference_details.description: A patient's GP practice number, to be linked to our own record.

lab_reference_details.name: Lab Reference Details
lab_reference_details.description: A patient's lab reference, to be linked to our own record.

triage.name: Triage
triage.description: Turns a GP referral into a case of our own, decides whether to accept, ask for more information, or decline it, and may hand an accepted case to a consultant.

referral_case.name: Referral Case
referral_case.description: One referral, from the moment it becomes a case of ours.

register_referral.name: Register Referral
register_referral.description: Creates a case of our own from a referral the GP practice system sent.

referral_registered.name: Referral Registered
referral_registered.description: A referral has become a case of ours.

accept_referral.name: Accept Referral
accept_referral.description: Called by the triage nurse once she is satisfied the case should go ahead.

referral_accepted.name: Referral Accepted
referral_accepted.description: A case has been accepted and is ready to be scheduled.

request_more_information.name: Request More Information
request_more_information.description: Called by the triage nurse when the referral does not yet say enough to decide.

more_information_requested.name: More Information Requested
more_information_requested.description: Triage has asked the GP for more information before it can decide. Only triage itself tracks this.

decline_referral.name: Decline Referral
decline_referral.description: Called by the triage nurse when the referral is not taken up.

assign_consultant.name: Assign Consultant
assign_consultant.description: Called by the triage nurse to hand a complicated accepted case to a consultant.

case_assigned_to_consultant.name: Case Assigned To Consultant
case_assigned_to_consultant.description: An accepted case has been handed to a named consultant.

record_lab_result.name: Record Lab Result
record_lab_result.description: Folds a lab result, already translated into our own terms, into the case.

referral.name: Referral
referral.description: A GP referral, once it is a case of ours rather than the GP's message.

patient_id.name: patientId
patient_id.description: Set once Records has matched this referral to one of our patients.

status_moves_forward_only.name: Status Moves Forward Only
status_moves_forward_only.description: A referral's status only ever moves on -- once accepted or declined, triage's other decisions no longer apply to it.

accepted_referral_carries_a_code.name: Accepted Referral Carries A Code
accepted_referral_carries_a_code.description: Once a referral is accepted it always carries a diagnosis code from the current coding standard.

one_active_referral_per_patient.name: One Active Referral Per Patient
one_active_referral_per_patient.description: A patient never has more than one active referral open with us at a time.

triage_assessment.name: Triage Assessment
triage_assessment.description: The clinical decision logic a referral is judged against. The nurse's own account is that the assessment itself calls out to Records for what is already known about the patient -- not an application service fronting the call -- so that is what is modelled here, even though a domain service is not meant to call outside its own context.

check_patient_history.name: Check Patient History
check_patient_history.description: Checks what Records already holds for this referral's patient.

referral_intake.name: Referral Intake
referral_intake.description: Takes what the GP's practice system sends and turns it into a case of our own.

lab_ordering.name: Lab Ordering
lab_ordering.description: Sends a patient for testing at the lab, and folds the result back into our own case once it is translated.

send_referral_for_testing.name: Send Referral For Testing
send_referral_for_testing.description: Called once the assessment decides a test is needed.

register_referral_on_submission.name: Register Referral On Submission
register_referral_on_submission.description: Every submitted referral becomes a case of ours.

record_lab_result_on_receipt.name: Record Lab Result On Receipt
record_lab_result_on_receipt.description: Every reported result is folded into the case it belongs to.

referral.name: Referral
referral.definition: A GP referral, once triage holds it as a case of its own.

assessment.name: Assessment
assessment.definition: The clinical decision logic a referral is judged against.

referral_details.name: Referral Details
referral_details.description: A referral, translated out of the GP practice system's own shape into ours.

referral_accepted_details.name: Referral Accepted Details
referral_accepted_details.description: Which case was accepted, and for which patient.

information_request_details.name: Information Request Details
information_request_details.description: What further information triage is asking the GP for.

consultant_assignment_details.name: Consultant Assignment Details
consultant_assignment_details.description: Which consultant an accepted case has been handed to.

lab_test_request_details.name: Lab Test Request Details
lab_test_request_details.description: The test triage wants run, in our own terms.

lab_result_details.name: Lab Result Details
lab_result_details.description: A lab result, translated out of the lab's own report shape into ours.

patient_history_check_request.name: Patient History Check Request
patient_history_check_request.description: Which patient the assessment needs to know about.

scheduling.name: Scheduling
scheduling.description: Turns an accepted case into a booked clinic slot, and keeps the record of clinics, slots, bookings and cancellations.

clinic_schedule.name: Clinic Schedule
clinic_schedule.description: One clinic session and its bookable slots.

clinic_session.name: Clinic Session
clinic_session.description: A run of appointments on a given day with a given clinician.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: One bookable appointment time within a clinic session.

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: One patient booked, or waitlisted, against a slot.

booking_confirmed.name: Booking Confirmed
booking_confirmed.description: A patient confirmed the slot they were offered.

patient_waitlisted.name: Patient Waitlisted
patient_waitlisted.description: A patient was put on the waiting list instead of taking the offered slot.

cancel_booking.name: Cancel Booking
cancel_booking.description: Called by the patient or the scheduler to give up a confirmed booking.

booking.name: Booking
booking.description: A patient's claim on a slot, from an offer through to its outcome.

slot_offered_once.name: Slot Offered Once
slot_offered_once.description: A slot is never offered to a second patient while it is already held.

scheduling_desk.name: Scheduling Desk
scheduling_desk.description: Offers the patient a slot once triage accepts their case.

offer_slot.name: Offer Slot
offer_slot.description: Offers the patient the next open slot for the case's specialty. The patient's answer is not a refusal either way -- see DISCOVERY.md for why the second outcome is carried under rejects.

offer_slot_on_acceptance.name: Offer Slot On Acceptance
offer_slot_on_acceptance.description: Every accepted case is immediately offered a slot.

appointment_lifecycle.name: Appointment Lifecycle
appointment_lifecycle.description: Remembers a confirmed booking until either it is cancelled or the day of the appointment arrives; that is the whole of what a booking waits for.

appointment_day_reached.name: Appointment Day Reached
appointment_day_reached.description: The clinic session's own date arrives with no cancellation received.
appointment_day_reached.after: until the day of the appointment

clinic_session.name: Clinic Session
clinic_session.definition: A run of appointments on a given day with a given clinician.

slot.name: Slot
slot.definition: One bookable appointment time within a clinic session.

booking.name: Booking
booking.definition: A patient's claim on a slot.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.definition: Where a patient goes when an offered slot does not suit them, to wait for a better one.

slot_offer_request.name: Slot Offer Request
slot_offer_request.description: Which accepted case, and which patient, is being offered a slot.

booking_confirmed.name: Booking Confirmed
booking_confirmed.description: The patient took the offered slot.

patient_waitlisted.name: Patient Waitlisted
patient_waitlisted.description: The offered slot did not suit the patient, so they were put on the waiting list for a better one instead. Something happened here, just not a booking -- the model has no shape for a second thing that happened, so this is carried as a rejection for want of anywhere better (see DISCOVERY.md).

booking_cancelled_details.name: Booking Cancelled Details
booking_cancelled_details.description: Which booking was cancelled, and why.

relationships.description: The practice system's referral message is theirs to change; triage translates it into a case of our own on the way in.
Triage orders tests through the lab's documented interface and translates its own report format into a case's own terms.
Every accepted referral's diagnosis must carry a code from the regulator's published coding standard, taken as it is published.
Triage's assessment looks a patient up through Records' own directory and takes what it gets back as published.
Scheduling reacts to triage's own accepted-case fact, taking it as published.
Records takes triage's own registered-case fact as published.
